findings.entity: woman relative to car body (hood/cowl/A-pillar/door mirror)
findings.description: The woman's torso emerges from the hood/cowl directly in front of the windshield, forward of the near A-pillar and to the left of (in front of) the door-mounted side mirror, with arms crossed on the hood. She is neither inside the cabin leaning out the door window (the A-pillar and mirror would then be in front of/beside her and her arms would rest on the door sill behind the mirror) nor standing beside the fender (her legs/body would be visible, not hidden by the hood). Her body occupies the engine-bay/cowl volume, and this impossible placement persists throughout the orbit (e.g. 04:50, 06:00), where the side window and seat appear behind her rather than around her.

At 00:00 the pavement to the left of the car's nose is a plain band with no lane markings, and the background beyond the hood is open desert scrub. By ~03.5s-04.5s, with only a modest orbit, a marked two-lane road with yellow center dashes and white edge dashes appears immediately beyond the hood and runs straight to the horizon, implying the car sits in or beside a travel lane not compatible with the opening view.
